actions: OPEN INPUT PRES-IN FEE-TABLE OUTPUT PRES-OUT REPORT-OUT

rules.sentence: When `WS-FEE-STATUS` is not `'00'`, it opens `PRES-IN` and `FEE-TABLE` for input and `PRES-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; and stops the run.

When `WS-FEE-STATUS` is `'00'` and `WS-DEFAULT-COUNT` is more than zero, it opens `PRES-IN` and `FEE-TABLE` for input and `PRES-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; repeats its loop until `WS-AT-END` is `'Y'` (`PRESENTMENTS-AT-END`); performs `WRITE-REPORT`; closes `PRES-IN`, `FEE-TABLE`, `PRES-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT`; and stops the run.

When `WS-FEE-STATUS` is `'00'` and `WS-DEFAULT-COUNT` is at most zero, it opens `PRES-IN` and `FEE-TABLE` for input and `PRES-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; repeats its loop until `WS-AT-END` is `'Y'` (`PRESENTMENTS-AT-END`); performs `WRITE-REPORT`; closes `PRES-IN`, `FEE-TABLE`, `PRES-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT`; and stops the run.

conditions: READ PRES-IN INTO PRES-RECORD AT END

rules.sentence: When reading `PRES-IN` finds no more records, it reads `PRES-IN` into `PRES-RECORD` and sets `WS-AT-END` to `PRESENTMENTS-AT-END`.
When reading `PRES-IN` finds a record, it reads `PRES-IN` into `PRES-RECORD` and performs `PRICE-PRESENTMENT`.

actions: CALL 'feeslot' USING PS-PRODUCT PS-REGION WS-GROUP RETURNING WS-SLOT
COMPUTE PS-FEE ROUNDED = PS-AMOUNT * DEFAULT-RATE + DEFAULT-FIXED-CENTS / 100
COMPUTE PS-FEE ROUNDED = PS-AMOUNT * FS-RATE + FS-FIXED-CENTS / 100

rules.sentence: When `PS-MATCH` is `'M'` (`PS-MATCHED`) and reading `FEE-TABLE` fails on its key, it sets `PS-FEE` to zero, performs `FIND-GROUP`, calls `FEESLOT`, reads `FEE-TABLE`, adds 1 to `WS-DEFAULT-COUNT`, computes `PS-FEE` as `PS-AMOUNT * DEFAULT-RATE + DEFAULT-FIXED-CENTS / 100`, adds `PS-FEE` to `WS-FEES`, and writes `PRES-RECORD`.

When `PS-MATCH` is `'M'` (`PS-MATCHED`) and reading `FEE-TABLE` succeeds by its key, it sets `PS-FEE` to zero, performs `FIND-GROUP`, calls `FEESLOT`, reads `FEE-TABLE`, computes `PS-FEE` as `PS-AMOUNT * FS-RATE + FS-FIXED-CENTS / 100`, adds `PS-FEE` to `WS-FEES`, and writes `PRES-RECORD`.
When `PS-MATCH` is not `'M'` (not `PS-MATCHED`), it sets `PS-FEE` to zero and writes `PRES-RECORD`.
When `PS-MCC` is at least 5411 and `PS-MCC` is at most 5499, it sets `WS-GROUP` to `GROUP-GROCERY`.
When `PS-MCC` is less than 5411 or `PS-MCC` is more than 5499; and `PS-MCC` is at least 5811 and `PS-MCC` is at most 5814, it sets `WS-GROUP` to `GROUP-RESTAURANTS`.

When `PS-MCC` is less than 5411 or `PS-MCC` is more than 5499; `PS-MCC` is less than 5811 or `PS-MCC` is more than 5814; and both `PS-MCC` is at least 3000 and `PS-MCC` is at most 3999 or both `PS-MCC` is at least 4111 and `PS-MCC` is at most 4789, it sets `WS-GROUP` to `GROUP-TRAVEL`.

When `PS-MCC` is less than 5411 or `PS-MCC` is more than 5499; `PS-MCC` is less than 5811 or `PS-MCC` is more than 5814; either `PS-MCC` is less than 3000 or `PS-MCC` is more than 3999 and either `PS-MCC` is less than 4111 or `PS-MCC` is more than 4789; and `PS-MCC` is 5541, `PS-MCC` is 5542, or `PS-MCC` is 5983, it sets `WS-GROUP` to `GROUP-FUEL`.

When `PS-MCC` is less than 5411 or `PS-MCC` is more than 5499; `PS-MCC` is less than 5811 or `PS-MCC` is more than 5814; either `PS-MCC` is less than 3000 or `PS-MCC` is more than 3999 and either `PS-MCC` is less than 4111 or `PS-MCC` is more than 4789; and `PS-MCC` is not 5541, `PS-MCC` is not 5542, and `PS-MCC` is not 5983, it sets `WS-GROUP` to `GROUP-OTHER`.
